# Phriend

> Phriend is a Philippine marketplace for booking local services from verified providers: aircon cleaning and repair, appliance check-ups, bookkeeping and tax filing, tutoring, photography and video, driving, errands and deliveries, moving help, tour guiding, event coordination and more. Clients browse services, each with its own price (per job, per hour or per session), photos of the work, visit type, schedule and area. Booking and chat happen in the app; payment is agreed with the provider and paid to them directly.

- Website: https://phriend.app
- Client app: Phriend (Android, iOS) and https://web.phriend.app in the browser
- Provider app: https://provider.phriend.app (the Phriend Provider app is coming to the app stores)
- Contact: support@phriend.app
- Launched 2026 in the Philippines. Nationwide, Metro Manila first.
- Full text of the FAQ, trust and safety rules and community guidelines: https://phriend.app/llms-full.txt

## What Phriend is

- A services marketplace. Clients browse services, not people. Each service has its own price per job, per hour or per session, up to 6 photos of the work, a visit type (online/remote, in person or hybrid), its own schedule and its own area (listed areas, a whole city, or nationwide for online work).
- Providers keep a lean profile: one round face photo, a name, a title such as "Online Bookkeeper", a short About me, the languages they speak, their services, a Verified badge, and document badges for what Phriend's team checked.
- Not a party to any booking or payment. Phriend holds no money, processes no payments and, at the time of writing, takes no commission.
- For legitimate services only. Sexual or romantic services, dating and escort services are banned and get an account removed immediately.

## How it works

Clients:
1. Browse services by what you need and where. Each one shows its price, photos of the work, whether it is online, in person or hybrid, the area it covers and the provider's badges.
2. Chat with the provider in the app. Their FAQ answers reply instantly to the usual questions: how to pay, the minimum booking, where they work.
3. Book a time from the service's own schedule and, for an at-home service, pick one of your saved addresses. Online services need no address. The provider accepts or declines.
4. Get it done, online or in person. Pay the provider directly, as you agreed with them, then leave a review.

Providers (at provider.phriend.app):
1. Verify your identity with a government ID and a selfie. Add an NBI clearance, police clearance, barangay certificate, certificates, business documents or proof of address to earn a badge for each one our team checks. Not all are required.
2. Set up a lean profile: one face photo, your name, a title, a short About me (no emojis) and your languages.
3. List each service with its own price per job, hour or session, up to 6 photos of your work, a visit type, a schedule and an area. A person reviews each listing before it goes live.
4. Accept booking requests, chat with clients and set FAQ answers that reply instantly. Clients pay you directly; you keep 100%.

## Features

- Services first: browse services, each with its own price, photos, visit type, schedule and area.
- Online, in person or hybrid: online services cover the whole country; in-person ones list the areas they cover, or a whole city.
- Saved addresses: save Home, Work and any other address for at-home services. An address is shared with a provider only for a booking at it.
- Bookings: pick a time from the service's schedule; accept, decline or cancel with a reason; add it to your calendar.
- Chat: photos, read receipts and typing indicators; archive or block anyone.
- Instant FAQ answers: providers set answers to the usual questions and the chat replies with them right away.
- Verified and document badges: Verified means our team checked a government ID and a selfie; document badges show what else was checked.
- Reviews: a star rating, a few words and photos, left after a booking.
- Post a job: describe what you need with a budget and a date; providers reply in the chat.
- Teams: a few verified providers offering a service together, with packages and one group chat.
- Notifications: a bell in the app and an email for every message, booking update and review.
- Account: sign in with Google or email; delete your account yourself at any time.

## The rules (short version)

1. Book verified providers, and check the document badges that matter for the job.
2. Agree the price, the time and what is included in the chat and the booking, so both sides have the record.
3. Payment is agreed with the provider and paid to them directly: cash, e-wallet or bank transfer. Never pay more upfront than was agreed in the chat, never a fee on top, and only to the account the provider gave you in the chat.
4. Every service says where it happens: online, at the client's place, at the provider's place, or either. Never in hotel rooms or as overnight stays.
5. Late more than 30 minutes without notice: the other side may cancel; a provider who is late or cancels late refunds anything already paid. Cancel at least 24 hours ahead, in the app with a reason.
6. Report a profile or a job post (up to 4 photos as evidence) and block from the chat. Reports get an automated first pass; unclear cases go to a moderator; serious cases go to the authorities.
7. Emergencies: call 911 first, report to Phriend after.

Allowed: aircon, appliance, plumbing, electrical and handyman work; home cleaning, laundry and moving help; bookkeeping, tax filing, virtual assistance, design and consulting; tutoring and lessons, online or in person; photography and video; event coordination, hosting, hair and makeup, catering; driving, airport transfers, errands, deliveries and queueing; tour and trip guiding; hospital and senior care help; pet care; car wash, detailing and mechanics.

Banned: any sexual or romantic service, dating or escort services, listings that sell a person's company rather than a service, drugs, anything illegal under Philippine law, harassment, impersonation, payment scams, fake reviews and multiple accounts.

## Pricing

- Phriend charges members nothing: no commission, no booking fees, no in-app payments.
- Each provider prices each service per job, per hour or per session. The price and any minimum booking show on the service before you book.
